description: Generate a textured GLB from a text prompt or reference image URLs via Replicate (Hunyuan-3D 3.1 by default; configurable). Returns the GLB URL and a new avatar session you can dress + animate. Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and REPLICATE_TEXT_TO_AVATAR_MODEL on the MCP server.

name.description: Name for the resulting avatar session.

prompt.description: Text description of the avatar to generate.

texture.description: Request PBR textures when supported (default true).

voice.description: TTS voice the session should use.

name: generate_avatar
title: Generate a 3D avatar (Replicate text-to-3D)
